name: DualTransitionBuilder
coverage: Read the routing and interruption behavior; existing Rust tests crates/incular-widgets/tests/explicit_transitions.rs (dual_transition_builder_routes_the_animation_to_the_running_side, an_interrupted_dual_transition_keeps_playing_the_transition_it_started) cover direction and interruption but are not Flutter comparisons. No frame twin. Listener replacement and disposal ordering unchecked.

name: AnimatedWidgetBaseState
coverage: Read: ImplicitState rebuilds on every animation tick (implicit_animations.rs:144-198, comment at 146-147). Covered for the implicit family by the retarget and curve scenarios; the public subclass base has no Incular equivalent (see transitions-007 for the explicit side).

name: DefaultTransitionDelegate
coverage: Reassigned to navigation. rg for TransitionDelegate, transition_delegate, exiting_route and RouteTransitionRecord in navigation, runtime, widgets and route outlet found no delegate API. Removed and replaced route transitions are handled inside runtime route_outlet.rs (not compared). Candidate for navigation worker.

name: RouteTransitionRecord
coverage: Reassigned to navigation. rg for RouteTransitionRecord and transition_record found nothing. Route records are internal to runtime route_outlet.rs (not compared).

name: TransitionDelegate
coverage: Reassigned to navigation. rg for TransitionDelegate found no abstract delegate in crates. Candidate for navigation worker.

name: FadeUpwardsPageTransitionsBuilder
coverage: Out of scope: Material theme page-transition builder (page_transitions_builder.dart:144). Incular has a FadeUpwards variant only in incular-material page_transitions.rs:30-31, which is Material theme configuration.

name: OpenUpwardsPageTransitionsBuilder
coverage: Out of scope: Material theme page-transition builder (page_transitions_builder.dart:321). rg for OpenUpwards found no Incular counterpart; Material-only configuration.

name: PageTransitionsBuilder
coverage: Reassigned to navigation. The builder interface is matched at incular-navigation/src/presentation.rs:426 (Flutter PageTransitionsBuilder.buildTransitions). Material defaults at incular-material/src/page_transitions.rs:22 are Material theme configuration (out of scope). Only interface shape checked.

name: TransitionRoute
coverage: Reassigned to navigation. Route animation ownership is checked by source: Incular presentation.rs:431 and runtime route_outlet.rs:405 and 895 (opaque only when fully pushed) match the TransitionRoute role. Status-transition and animation callbacks not compared.

name: StatusTransitionWidget
coverage: Read the Flutter base (status_transitions.dart:9-40): it rebuilds on every AnimationStatus change via a status listener and has no subclass in lib/src/widgets. Incular has no public status-only rebuild base; the closest is the internal effective-status logic of DualTransitionBuilder (animation_transitions.rs:496-514). Gap recorded as transitions-010; no frame twin.

name: AlignTransition
coverage: Physical alignment checked by transitions__layout__align. Directional AlignmentGeometry gap cross-referenced to implicit-003.

name: AnimatedBuilder
coverage: transitions__builders__cached_child checks build counts and cached child geometry across animation ticks.

name: AnimatedWidget
coverage: Read: Incular's animated_widget_for helper (explicit_animations.rs:95) rebuilds on controller notification; no public subclassable base. Custom subclass lifecycle not checked (transitions-007).

name: DecoratedBoxTransition
coverage: BoxDecoration color interpolation checked by transitions__paint__decoration_matrix. Other Decoration types not accepted (transitions-005).

name: DefaultTextStyleTransition
coverage: transitions__text__default_style: width matches; line-box height differs by 1 px on frames 3-5 (same fractional Inter metric as implicit-002, not refiled). Paragraph options unavailable (implicit-006).

name: FadeTransition
coverage: Opacity checked by transitions__compositor__fade_slide_scale_rotation. alwaysIncludeSemantics unavailable (implicit-004).

name: ListenableBuilder
coverage: Read: ListenableBuilder (explicit_animations.rs:225-250) rebuilds on listenable notification. The frame suite covers the closure AnimatedBuilder only; no frame twin for ListenableBuilder.

name: MatrixTransition
coverage: Translation with default center alignment checked by transitions__paint__decoration_matrix. filterQuality has no equivalent (transitions-003).

name: PositionedTransition
coverage: transitions__positioned__relative_rect checks the rectangle path with non-null rectangles.

name: RelativePositionedTransition
coverage: Non-null rectangles checked by transitions__positioned__relative_rect. Nullable rectangle animation unavailable (transitions-004).

name: RelativeRectTween
coverage: No named RelativeRectTween type: rg -n RelativeRectTween over crates/ returns nothing. The generic TweenAnimation<RelativeRect> is used by the scenario and interpolates the same values.

name: RotationTransition
coverage: Turns at center alignment checked by transitions__compositor__fade_slide_scale_rotation. filterQuality unavailable (transitions-003).

name: ScaleTransition
coverage: Scale at center alignment checked by transitions__compositor__fade_slide_scale_rotation. filterQuality unavailable (transitions-003).

name: SizeTransition
coverage: Horizontal clip at factors 1 and 0.5 (transitions__layout__size_clip) and a vertical reversal mid-flight (transitions__size__reverse_mid_flight) match. Not checked: a negative fixedCrossAxisSizeFactor (transitions-008); child clipping is not visible to the outer probe.

name: SlideTransition
coverage: LTR translation checked by transitions__compositor__fade_slide_scale_rotation. Reading direction and transformHitTests are not available (transitions-001, transitions-002).

name: SliverFadeTransition
coverage: transitions__sliver_fade__opacity sets the controller directly and matches opacity and geometry. Animation<double> input is not accepted (transitions-006); alwaysIncludeSemantics unavailable (implicit-004).

name: ValueListenableBuilder
coverage: rg -n ValueListenableBuilder crates/ returns no public widget. Not a transition; reassigned as a builder primitive for another package to decide.
